title: Revised Code of Washington, Title 50 (Unemployment Compensation), Chapter 50.20 - Benefits and Claims
verified_how: fetched https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/default.aspx?cite=50.20 (HTTP 200): breadcrumb 'Home / State laws and rules / RCWs / Title 50 / Chapter 50.20', heading 'Chapter 50.20 RCW - BENEFITS AND CLAIMS', with 'Complete chapter' HTML and PDF links, an 'RCW dispositions' link and a full section list. Currency: the RCW index page (https://app.leg.wa.gov/RCW/) states 'Last update: July 15, 2026' and explains that 'The online version of the RCW is updated twice a year, once in the early fall following the legislative session, and again at the end of the year if a ballot measure that changes the law passed at the general election'; it also records that 'The Statute Law Committee declares that the certified PDF publication documents in the RCW Archive area on the Office of the Code Reviser's website constitute the official publication of the Revised Code of Washington', so this HTML version is the working rather than the certified text. The register flags amended-but-not-yet-merged text by printing a section two or three times with '(as amended by 2026 c NN)' suffixes.
notes: Washington employment is at will: there is NO Washington statute requiring severance pay, notice of individual termination, or a state mini-WARN filing (Washington relies on the federal WARN Act, 29 U.S.C. ch. 23). The nearest principal statute is the unemployment compensation benefit scheme, whose qualification and disqualification rules turn on the reason for separation. Termination for a discriminatory reason is dealt with by chapter 49.60 RCW (Washington law against discrimination), which was not separately fetched in this pass.
